import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd()
def write(n,v):
 z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),n],input=json.dumps(v,indent=2)+'\n',text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=10);assert z.returncode==0,z.stderr
f=json.loads((p/'frozen-after.json').read_text());assert f['count']==32 and not f['mismatches']
rs=[]
for x in sorted(p.glob('*.receipt.json')):
 v=json.loads(x.read_text());rs.append({'file':x.name,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(x.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'name':v['name'],'exit':v['exit'],'killed':v['killed'],'sampled_group_rss_peak_bytes':v['sampled_group_rss_peak_bytes'],'wall_s':v['wall_s'],'limits':{k:v[k] for k in ['affinity','cpu_limit_s','as_limit_bytes','group_rss_guard_bytes','deadline_s','env_overrides']}})
write('receipt-inventory.json',{'completed_runner_receipts':rs,'count_before_terminal':len(rs),'explicit_exception_receipts':['bootstrap-receipt.json','frozen-before.json','frozen-after.json'],'terminal_receipt':'terminal_seal.receipt.json (created after seal child; preserved, excluded from manifest only)','terminal_output':'terminal_seal.output.txt (same sequencing)','limits':'Sampled helper telemetry; no native/transient/writer/supervisor/cgroup universal assurance.','network':{'fresh_search_calls':0,'fresh_GET_hops':0,'new_guard_receipts':[]}})
policy=json.loads((p/'TERMINAL-EXCLUSIONS.json').read_text());exclude=set(policy['excluded'])
entries=[]
for x in sorted(p.rglob('*')):
 assert not x.is_symlink(),str(x)
 if x.is_file() and x.name not in exclude:
  data=x.read_bytes();entries.append({'path':str(x.relative_to(p)),'bytes':len(data),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()})
write('SHA256-MANIFEST.json',{'target':323694,'entries':entries,'file_count':len(entries),'exclusions':policy,'frozen_after':f,'campaign':{'credit':0,'new':57,'goal':60,'prior':39,'total':96}})
print('SEALED',len(entries),'own files;',len(rs),'completed pre-terminal runner receipts; frozen32 unchanged; exact exclusions:',','.join(sorted(exclude)))
